_metadata.description: Deferred user scene studio for private custom scene templates under an explicit budget.

requirements.title: Users may create private scene templates under a budget
requirements.description: A later scene studio may let a user choose a starter or reference, describe an environment, generate empty wide, compact, light, and evening variants under an explicit budget, mark food and safe text regions, preview bowl, plate, and tall-vessel cases, and approve a private template, without a room editor or a general 3D engine.

validation.notes: Planned: deferred; review the studio design against R18.5 and the generation budget policy before any implementation begins.

requirements.title: Uploaded backgrounds are not automatically templates
requirements.description: The scenario may accept an uploaded background only as a candidate that must pass the same metadata, safe-region, and preview validation as curated templates before it can be used for composition.

validation.notes: Planned: deferred; an arbitrary uploaded background is never treated as a reliable composition template without validation (R18.5).
